## Issue tracking

For PRs from open-source community contributors:

- **New features**: a linked issue is **required**. Please open a [feature request](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/issues/new?template=feature_request.md) and reference it here before submitting the PR.

Linked issue: <!-- e.g. Fixes #1234 / Related to #1234 -->

## Code provenance

You should always make a best effort to avoid copying code from other
 repositories. In exceptional cases in which this is unavoidable and you copied
 or adapted code from an external source, provide the following details and
 copy to the file header:

- Source URL, revision, and original file(s):
- Files in this PR containing the copied or adapted code:
- Applicable license(s):
- Required copyright notices and attribution, and where they are retained or added:

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [ ] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment `@NVIDIA/mcore-oncall` to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

1. When your PR is ready, click **Ready for Review**.
2. An oncall reviewer is auto-assigned and expert reviewers are notified based on your changes.
   - Some PRs may jump straight to step 2. This is determined by `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

:warning: Only mark as ready once merge-conflicts are resolved and the CI is passing.
Final Review might get declined if these requirements are not fulfilled.

#### Step 2: Final Review

For PRs that change `megatron/core`, once all expert reviewers have approved, the `Final Review` label is applied **automatically** and final reviewers are assigned.

For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped.

#### Step 3: Approved

Once all required reviewers have approved, the `Approved` label is applied **automatically**.

### Merge

Any member of [mcore-engineers](https://github.com/orgs/NVIDIA/teams/mcore-engineers) will be able to merge your PR.

@@ -650,38 +650,82 @@ def _is_fused_impl_supported(self) -> bool:
         # Leave CuTeDSL eligibility and layout checks to TE's fusion matcher.
         return True
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _grouped_linear_param_names(
+        linear: torch.nn.Module, single_grouped_weight: bool, single_grouped_bias: bool
+    ) -> list[str]:
+        """Names of the source GroupedLinear parameters that a fused op exposes."""
+        names = (
+            ["weight"]
+            if single_grouped_weight
+            else [f"weight{idx}" for idx in range(linear.num_gemms)]
+        )
+        if linear.use_bias:
+            names += (
+                ["bias"]
+                if single_grouped_bias
+                else [f"bias{idx}" for idx in range(linear.num_gemms)]
+            )
+        return names
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _register_grouped_linear_params(
+        op: torch.nn.Module,
+        linear: torch.nn.Module,
+        single_grouped_weight: bool,
+        single_grouped_bias: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Give a fused op the weights exposed by its source GroupedLinear."""
+        if single_grouped_weight:
+            op.register_parameter("weight", linear.get_parameter("weight"))
+            for idx in range(linear.num_gemms):
+                op.register_parameter(f"weight{idx}", None)
+        else:
+            op.register_parameter("weight", None)
+            for idx in range(linear.num_gemms):
+                op.register_parameter(f"weight{idx}", getattr(linear, f"weight{idx}"))
+
+        if not linear.use_bias:
+            return
+
+        if single_grouped_bias:
+            op.register_parameter("bias", linear.get_parameter("bias"))
+            for idx in range(linear.num_gemms):
+                op.register_parameter(f"bias{idx}", None)
+        else:
+            op.register_parameter("bias", None)
+            for idx in range(linear.num_gemms):
+                op.register_parameter(f"bias{idx}", linear.get_parameter(f"bias{idx}"))
+
+    def _rebind_fused_ops_params(self) -> None:
+        """Point the fused ops at the source GroupedLinears' current parameter objects.
+
+        The fused ops register the source Parameter objects when they are built. FSDP
+        implementations that swap Parameter objects on unshard/reshard (e.g. MFSDP v2
+        installs sharded DTensors at rest and separate unsharded parameters for compute)
+        leave those registrations stale, so the fused kernels would read released sharded
+        storage. Re-register only when an object actually changed.
+        """
+        for op, linear, single_grouped_weight, single_grouped_bias in getattr(
+            self, "_fused_param_bindings", ()
+        ):
+            names = self._grouped_linear_param_names(
+                linear, single_grouped_weight, single_grouped_bias
+            )
+            if any(op._parameters.get(name) is not linear._parameters.get(name) for name in names):
+                self._register_grouped_linear_params(
+                    op, linear, single_grouped_weight, single_grouped_bias
+                )

@@ -608,6 +608,79 @@ def fc2_hook(submodule, _inp):
     assert visited == {"fc1", "fc2"}
 
 
+class _FakeGroupedLinear(torch.nn.Module):
+    """Minimal stand-in for TEGroupedLinear's parameter layout."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *, num_gemms, use_bias, single_grouped):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.num_gemms = num_gemms
+        self.use_bias = use_bias
+        self.fuse_wgrad_accumulation = False
+        if single_grouped:
+            self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_gemms, 2, 2))
+            if use_bias:
+                self.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_gemms, 2))
+        else:
+            for idx in range(num_gemms):
+                self.register_parameter(f"weight{idx}", torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2)))
+                if use_bias:
+                    self.register_parameter(f"bias{idx}", torch.nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(2)))
+
+
+def _module_with_fused_param_bindings():
+    module = TEGroupedMLP.__new__(TEGroupedMLP)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(module)
+    # fc1: one weight per expert, no bias; fc2: single grouped weight and bias.
+    module.linear_fc1 = _FakeGroupedLinear(num_gemms=2, use_bias=False, single_grouped=False)
+    module.linear_fc2 = _FakeGroupedLinear(num_gemms=2, use_bias=True, single_grouped=True)
+    fc1_op, fc2_op = torch.nn.Module(), torch.nn.Module()
+    bindings = ((fc1_op, module.linear_fc1, False, False), (fc2_op, module.linear_fc2, True, True))
+    for binding in bindings:
+        TEGroupedMLP._register_grouped_linear_params(*binding)
+    module._fused_param_bindings = bindings
+    return module, fc1_op, fc2_op
+
+
+def test_make_fused_impl_pre_forward_hook_rebinds_params_swapped_by_hooks():
+    # MFSDP v2 unshard hooks replace the source Parameter objects; the fused ops must
+    # follow them instead of keeping the stale sharded parameters registered at build time.
+    module, fc1_op, fc2_op = _module_with_fused_param_bindings()
+    stale_fc1_weight0 = fc1_op.weight0
+
+    def unshard_hook(submodule, _args):
+        for name, param in list(submodule._parameters.items()):
+            submodule._parameters[name] = torch.nn.Parameter(param.detach().clone())
+
+    module.linear_fc1.register_forward_pre_hook(unshard_hook, prepend=True)
+    module.linear_fc2.register_forward_pre_hook(unshard_hook, prepend=True)
+
+    hook = module._make_fused_impl_pre_forward_hook()
+    hook(object())
+
+    assert fc1_op.weight0 is module.linear_fc1.weight0
+    assert fc1_op.weight1 is module.linear_fc1.weight1
+    assert fc1_op.weight0 is not stale_fc1_weight0
+    assert fc1_op.weight is None
+    assert fc2_op.weight is module.linear_fc2.weight
+    assert fc2_op.bias is module.linear_fc2.bias
+    assert fc2_op.weight0 is None and fc2_op.bias1 is None
+
+
+def test_rebind_fused_ops_params_skips_unchanged_params(monkeypatch):
+    module, fc1_op, _ = _module_with_fused_param_bindings()
+    registered = []
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        TEGroupedMLP,
+        "_register_grouped_linear_params",
+        staticmethod(lambda *args: registered.append(args)),
+    )
+
+    module._rebind_fused_ops_params()
+
+    assert registered == []
+    assert fc1_op.weight0 is module.linear_fc1.weight0
+
+
 def test_make_fused_impl_pre_forward_hook_rejects_input_modifying_hook():
     module = TEGroupedMLP.__new__(TEGroupedMLP)
     torch.nn.Module.__init__(module)
